title: Among active schools in Santa Clara County that are charter schools, find t
question: Among active schools in Santa Clara County that are charter schools, find those whose SAT excellence rate exceeds 0.25 and whose eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17 is above the county-wide average for such schools. Return the school name, district, and the administrator’s first and last name.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS school_id,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_046" AS district,
    s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name,
    s."XCL_081" AS admin_last_name,
    CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" AS sat_excellence_rate,
    f."XCL_025" / f."XCL_024" AS meal_rate
  FROM schools AS s
  INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
    AND s."XCL_045" = 'Santa Clara'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND t."XCL_036" <> 0
    AND f."XCL_024" <> 0
    AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.25
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(meal_rate) AS avg_meal_rate
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.school_name,
  b.district,
  b.admin_first_name,
  b.admin_last_name
FROM base AS b
CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a
WHERE b.meal_rate > a.avg_meal_rate

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS school_id,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_046" AS district,
    s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name,
    s."XCL_081" AS admin_last_name,
    CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" AS sat_excellence_rate,
    f."XCL_025" / f."XCL_024" AS meal_rate
  FROM schools AS s
  INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
    AND s."XCL_045" = 'Santa Clara'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND t."XCL_036" <> 0
    AND f."XCL_024" <> 0
    AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.25
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(meal_rate) AS avg_meal_rate
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.school_name,
  b.district,
  b.admin_first_name,
  b.admin_last_name
FROM base AS b
CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a
WHERE b.meal_rate > a.avg_meal_rate
